label: Paris
description: I arrived in Paris in 2019 for my studies and never regretted it. I enjoy the balance between sports, activities, and work, and it helped me fully settle in France.

label: Ultranoir
description: In May 2022, I started a 6-month internship at Ultranoir. I worked on several projects and deepened my React skills. The team mentored me on production workflows—this experience partly inspired me to build my portfolio with Next.js.

label: Football
description: I'm a big soccer fan. I played competitively for much of my youth and now play with friends. I support PSG.

label: Sailing
description: From age 8 to 18, I sailed in Saint-Raphaël (pico, catamaran, ludic). I reached FFV level 4 and almost became a summer instructor.

label: Dreamline Studio
description: From June to September 2021, I completed a remote internship at Dreamline Studio, strengthening my WordPress skills. I’ve continued collaborating as a freelancer since.

label: Cairo
description: I was born and raised in Cairo and studied at the French Lycée. I visit regularly and speak Arabic fluently, which helps me adapt to diverse environments.

label: Karate
description: From 5 to 17, I practiced karate in Egypt with the same sensei and earned my first-dan black belt, training 2–3 times a week.

label: HETIC
description: I’m a graduate of HETIC, where we combine web development, design, and communication. Even while specializing in development, I kept a strong focus on design and team projects to understand all aspects of a product.

label: Piano
description: I studied piano for several years at the Russian Cultural Center in Egypt—and there’s a video of little Soliman playing on YouTube somewhere!

label: Aikido
description: Alongside karate, I learned Aikido with the same sensei. The philosophy—using an opponent’s energy—shaped my mindset even though I no longer practice.

label: Three.js Journey
description: I completed most of the Three.js Journey course, gaining solid foundations to create 3D experiences on the web.

label: Canada
description: I spent six months in Montréal in 2023 at LG2, focusing on UI architecture, animations, and high-performance frontend systems. This semester strengthened my foundations in software design and technical precision.

label: Languages
description: Fluent in French (native), English, and Arabic—useful for collaborating with international teams and clients.

label: Sparkles AI
description: In 2025, I co-founded Sparkles AI, an AI-driven web platform built with Next.js, Supabase, and Cloudflare. This project allowed me to explore system scalability, caching, and user memory architectures through vector search.

label: Travel & Exploration
description: I love discovering new cultures and places. Traveling has always inspired me, and I’m open to relocating abroad—especially to the U.S.—to keep growing both personally and professionally.

label: Wiz
description: Since 2024, I’ve been working at Wiz Media as a full-stack developer, contributing to both frontend and backend. I focus on performance optimization, scalable architectures, and API design using Next.js and Storyblok.
